data.heading: iB Cricket announces world's first Virtual Reality cricket League
data.description: iB Cricket and Viu together have announced the world's first Virtual Reality cricket league featuring 12 international cricketers, who will be competing against each other for the iB Cricket Super Over League title in Mumbai. Iconic cricketers like Virender Sehwag, Suresh Raina, and Brendon McCullum will be competing in the league.
